title: LLMs and People Both Learn to Form Conventions—Just Not with Each Other
one_sentence: 同质 dyads 显示 convention-like performance signatures，而 mixed human–AI dyads 即使采用 humanlike prompt 仍不能消除 accuracy/lexical-overlap gap。
problem: General-purpose LLM 是否能与 humans 在双向、角色互换的 multimodal reference game 中形成相同类型的 conventions？
method: 预注册比较 human–human、human–AI、AI–AI 在 10 tangrams×5 blocks/50 turns 中的 accuracy、message length 与 lexical overlap，并用第二实验操纵 humanlike prompt。
findings: Same-type dyads 出现不同程度的 accuracy/consistency gains；mixed human–AI dyads 持续落后。
Humanlike prompt 缩短表达并小幅提高 accuracy，却未可靠修复 lexical overlap gap。
real_contribution: 把 generic model capability 问题重构为 heterogeneous dyad compatibility，并显示表面模仿不足以解释或修复 mixed-dyad failure。
biggest_weakness: preprint；AI–AI 使用相同 GPT-5 copies 和 prompt，初始 overlap 很高，shared interpretive biases 是作者解释而非被直接操纵的机制。
claim_boundary: AI–AI 结果只能称 convention-like signatures；partner-specific origin 仍需 pseudo-dyad/partner-swap tests。
why_researcher_should_care: 提示 AMSC 不能只问模型会不会适应，而要问 humans 与 models 的 priors/representations 为什么在 mixed dyad 中不兼容。
evidence_notes: arXiv v1 from February 2026; outside the strict seven-day window and labeled first-run recovery.
Preprint and preregistered experiment details were audited.
